    The main results from the data form of Bongartz's Theorem 6 #

    BongartzDistributive is the data form of alternatives (2) and (3) of Theorem 3.10 (Bongartz's Theorem 6 and its proof) for distributive algebras: every distributive split basic minimal representation-infinite algebra over an algebraically closed field carries covering data with a Kronecker pair (Covering.PairCoveringData.toCoveringData builds L), or a monomial presentation with a band (Walk.MonomialBand.toWalkData turns a band into walk data). The representation-embedding property of the push-down functors is not assumed: the facts about S₋ (RepresentationEmbeddings/WalkConstruction/WalkCase.lean, RepresentationEmbeddings/CoveringConstruction/SimpleInjectiveFacts.lean) and Propositions 4.4, 4.7, 4.8 supply what Theorem 5.2 needs. Alternative (1), for nondistributive algebras, is proved in NonDistributive.

    By Propositions 4.4, 4.7 and 4.8 (PushDown.PdDatum.embeddingData), it implies the hypothesis DistributiveEmbeddingData, and hence Theorem A and the two corollaries.
